contracts.name: HALFTONE gradient and phase
contracts.status: measured vectors; general kernel remains an approximation profile
contracts.evidence: Source8x4 RGB R=(11*x+53*y)%256,G=(43*x+7*y)%256,B=(19*x+37*y)%256,X=99; source[0,0,8,4] to destination[8,8,3,2] yields rows[(19,25,20),(52,176,76),(83,62,131)] and[(152,43,112),(184,194,168),(216,80,223)]. Relative values are unchanged at destination[9,8] or[8,9]. Native direct andhandraw-record pixels equal independently inallthree engines. No SetBrushOrgEx orSetColorAdjustment call wasmade; defaults wereused butnotqueried. Ordinaryarea/bilinear profiles do not reproduce the sampled edge-sharpening. Negative-lobe/Lanczos-like filtering is strongest inference, consistent with the referenced Wine engineer report. Tested boundedLanczos variants get withinroughly8 channellevels butnoneisexact; parameter tuningfromthissinglegradient isnotproof oftheWindowsalgorithm.
